summary.text: Phil Tarver is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 36 (Calcasieu Parish), and was elected in 2019, according to the official House member page.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Phil Tarver's occupation as Auto Dealership Owner.
It lists education as B.S., Accounting, McNeese State University.

The page lists committee assignments including Appropriations, Education, Labor and Industrial Relations, the Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget and the House Select Committee on Homeland Security, and caucus affiliations including the Acadiana Delegation and the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.
